description: This file contains unit tests for vector operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, magnitude, distance, equality, copying, and swizzling in a Lua project. It uses a custom assert module for testing vector functions created by createVector.

methods.name: Vector.add
methods.description: Test for the vector addition function, verifying both the operator overload and static method versions.

methods.name: Vector.mult
methods.description: Test for the vector multiplication function, verifying both the operator overload and static method versions.

methods.name: Vector.sub
methods.description: Test for the vector subtraction function, verifying both the operator overload and static method versions.

methods.name: Vector.div
methods.description: Test for the vector division function, verifying both the operator overload and static method versions.

methods.name: Vector.idiv
methods.description: Test for the integer division of vectors, verifying both the operator overload and static method versions.

methods.name: Vector.mag
methods.description: Test for calculating the magnitude and squared magnitude of a vector.

methods.name: Vector.dist
methods.description: Test for the distance calculation between two vectors.

methods.name: Vector.equals
methods.description: Test for equality comparison between two vectors.

methods.name: Vector Swizzling
methods.description: Test for vector component swizzling, verifying proper reordering and grouping of vector components.
